title: Arkret Encrypted Payload Envelope
description: Minimal ciphertext wire. purpose, effective scope and Event kind come from the frozen signed outer Event; mls_group_id is derived from that scope; content_scheme comes from the exact referenced winning group state. The canonical pre-encryption header is reconstructed and is not duplicated on wire.

routing_context.description: Present only for a registered reaction outer Event kind. The reaction kind and routing_window=floor(unix_ms(outer.created_at)/3600000) are derived inputs to AAD/KDF and never wire fields. All non-reaction kinds forbid routing_context.

standard_mls_encryption_context.description: The absence of counter is the structural standard-MLS branch. The referenced winning group state MUST have content_scheme=mls_rfc9420.

exporter_mls_encryption_context.description: The required full-width counter is the structural exporter branch. The referenced winning group state MUST have content_scheme=mls_exporter_aead_v1.

encryption_context.description: Closed branch selected by counter presence and cross-checked against the content_scheme frozen by the exact group_state_ref. No caller-supplied scheme selector exists.
